goal: Update the Guix time-machine commit to bring in newer toolchains and build dependencies.
Fix reproducible Guix builds on non-x86 architectures including RISC-V and AArch64.
reviewability: The PR is in draft while testing across architectures continues, but code is functional.
agreement: Broad interest and active testing across platforms with matching Guix build hashes on x86_64 (0xB10C, willcl-ark).
Architecture-specific build quirks on AArch64 and RISC-V are actively being tested and worked around (hebasto, janb84, maflcko).

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it upgrades the core Guix reproducible build toolchain and unblocks release builds on secondary architectures like RISC-V.

result.summary: Updates the Guix time-machine snapshot commit, bumping binutils to 2.47, CMake to 4.3.3, and Linux kernel headers to 6.1.187, while making GCC 16 and Clang 22/23 available. It also adjusts build scripts to accommodate CMake 4, skips broken psutil tests on RISC-V, and disables fixincludes on gcc-sans-libc to fix cross-compilation errors on AArch64.
result.problem: The current Guix time-machine pins an older environment with known build failures on non-x86 platforms like RISC-V (#36232) and lacks newer compiler toolchains required for ongoing build system maintenance.

open_concerns: AArch64 native and cross-compilation failures during gcc-sans-libc build were reported, addressed via `--disable-fixincludes`, and are awaiting re-testing.
A local checksum mismatch on binutils was reported by willcl-ark but suspected to be environment-specific.
resolved_concerns: Deterministic Guix build outputs on x86_64 were verified to match across three contributors.
RISC-V build failure caused by psutil tests in python-lief was addressed by filtering out those tests.
discussion.author_status: Active; recently pushed updates addressing AArch64 build failures.

reviewability.label: Ready
reviewability.reason: Although marked draft, multiple reviewers have successfully reproduced builds on x86_64 and testing is underway on other platforms.

agreement.summary: Positive; multiple contributors verified matching x86_64 build hashes and helped diagnose AArch64 issues.
agreement.reason: General consensus favors keeping Guix time-machine updated, and multiple reviewers have run the builds, with discussion focused on platform fixes rather than objections to the upgrade.
evidence: 0xB10C and willcl-ark confirmed matching x86_64 Guix hashes with the author
hebasto and janb84 helped diagnose AArch64 cross-gcc build failures
maflcko suggested factoring out some fixes into standalone PRs

categories.rationale: Release binary reproducibility and toolchain currency are central to Guix maintenance. This update resolves platform build breakages such as RISC-V (#36232) and updates binutils and CMake to support future build improvements.

result.card: This PR updates the Guix time-machine pin to a newer commit, upgrading binutils, CMake, Linux headers, and available GCC/Clang compilers. It solves build failures on secondary host architectures, notably RISC-V (#36232) and AArch64. Multiple maintainers have confirmed identical non-codesigning Guix build hashes on x86_64, and the PR remains in draft solely while non-x86 platform fixes are validated.
